source.method: Recovered SHA-pinned normative PDF from the repository source-probe artifact; located each selected whole-character target row from the table text, rendered the actual table row, and visually inspected the cumulative stroke diagrams. Secondary data were not used to grant migration review.

policy: Position migration is closed only for the recorded whole-character context. Stroke indices are whole-character indices. Formal GF0011—2022 attached-form status remains independent and pending item-level 2022 data.
